hypothesis: Model C finds characters of tori because the interaction is complex multiply. A different compositional slot — coordinatewise min of real heads — can express the valuation-meet formula gcd(a,b)=product p^min(v_p(a),v_p(b)). That is a lattice/tropical algorithm, not a U(1)-homomorphism. SGD must learn the embeddings; min is fixed and not initialized from valuations.
architecture: Model T: shared table E in R^{N x H}, H=number of locked primes, h=min(E[a],E[b]) coordinatewise, linear readout W,b. Xavier, no valuation init.
protocol: held_row a0=6 (largest a with 2a<=N, so every gcd class including 7..12 still appears in train; a0=N would drop gcd=N). P=1024, 8000 Adam steps, lr=3e-3, seed=0, float32 domain_acc>=1.0. Do not relax the gate. Do not initialize from v_p. Do not train Model C on this table in this run.

tables.gcd_meet: T(a,b)=gcd(a,b) on {1..12}. Positive: the lattice meet.
tables.gcd_destroyed: Symmetric shuffle of off-diagonal gcd entries, diagonal gcd(a,a)=a kept, seed 20260910. Preserves commutativity and off-diagonal frequencies. Destroys the valuation-meet law.

not_this_type: A faithful complex character of (Z/pZ)* (Family F).
Euclid-mod traces or Stein binary GCD as a state machine (not in the decoder list; do not add them after a miss).

certificate.C1_domain_exact: float32 domain accuracy 1 on all 144 pairs
certificate.C2_valuation_assignment: Hungarian match of H heads to the locked primes by affine R^2 of E[:,h] vs v_p; every scale α>0
certificate.C3_min_decoder: neural-free: snap each head to α v_p+β, take min per prime, round exponents, reconstruct product. Must be 100% exact on the task table
certificate.C4_drop_one_prime: Permute one snapped head across residues. Decoder must fail.
certificate.C5_sum_is_wrong_algebra: Replace min by sum on the snapped table. Decoder must fail. Distinguishes tropical meet from an additive character-like rule on the same coordinates.

predictions.P1_exact_exists_meet: On gcd_meet, at least one domain-exact net (capacity).
predictions.P2_certified_not_guaranteed: A certified valuation-min family may appear and may not. Presence is the measurement. Do not treat a high exact rate as the lattice algorithm.
predictions.P3_sum_never_certifies_min_nets: No net that passes C3 also passes C5 (sum). Vacuous if n_certified=0.
predictions.P4_destroyed_zero_certified: On gcd_destroyed, n_certified=0. Exact nets there are Class 1 interpolation.
predictions.P5_do_not_add_primes: If n_certified=0 on gcd_meet, do not add primes (13), do not raise H, do not valuation-init, do not add Euclid/Stein decoders, do not loosen exactness.
predictions.P7_not_model_c: Do not score this run with a dlog-circle / CRT certificate.

success_gate: The run completes under the locked protocol and scores P1–P5. Scientific valuation-min claim requires n_certified>0 on gcd_meet and n_certified=0 on gcd_destroyed. Zero on the meet table is a valid miss.
decoder_sanity_before_training: C3–C5 must hold on synthetic E[a,p]=v_p(a) against gcd_meet. The same synthetic E must fail C3 against gcd_destroyed.
